lines: The sound of memory opening
Because I want to hear it
I'll hold it out to you
Ah, something so
precious, this longing too
the sands of time bury it over
and leave it blurred, I'm afraid
That the word 'destiny' is cheap —
the you I'm laughing beside
might be that very person
Surely
we all forget
the things that matter, little by little
So my memories with you
let me entrust you with even a few
A puzzle that could never be complete
the last piece I kept hidden
The sound of memory opening
Because I want to hear it
I'll hold it out to you
Ah, memories so uncertain
that only their outlines
like thorns
tighten around my heart
All along
I've kept this quietly blooming longing pressed shut
and surrendered myself to reminiscence
But that way nothing changes, does it
Surely
we all forget
the things that matter, little by little
So my memories with you
let me entrust you with even a few
A puzzle that could never be complete
the last piece I kept hidden
The sound of memory opening
Because I want to hear it
I'll hold it out to you
Everything becoming vivid and clear
anyone would want that dream to come true
Even if it's all a misunderstanding
don't be afraid, let's go on
Sleeping deep, deep down
let's scoop up that voice
Surely
though we all forget
the things that matter, little by little
in the depths of the heart
they're waiting for us
A puzzle meant to be complete
the last piece that stayed hidden
The sound of memory opening
Because I want to hear it
I'll hold it out to you
